items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Well he had him, and me, and himself, and he had a violin player named Clowns Lee.

ctx.x: Well along the subject of drummers in Chicago, ever remember Andrew Hillier?
Sure I remember Andrew Good. Who was he with? He died, didn't he? Yeah. Yeah, we used to call him Hillier, yeah.
